hebrewText: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣/נִּי וְ/אַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּ/טֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נִּי

tokens.bdb: to gaze at or about (properly, for help); by implication, to inspect, consider, compassionate, be nonplussed (as looking around in amazement) or bewildered
tokens.kjv: depart, be dim, be dismayed, look (away), regard, have respect, spare, turn.

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

tokens.bdb: to break off or loose (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), i.e. desist (from grief) or invade (with destruction)
properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before
to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, [phrase] follow(-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, made) go (away, -ing, -ne, one's way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, [phrase] pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (-journey), vanish, (cause to) walk(-ing), wax, [idiom] be weak.

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
